India and Pakistan have no direct trade following the Pahalgam terror attack.
Yet Pakistan imported goods worth $61.74 million from India between April and June 2026.
This was 69% higher than the same period last year, when imports stood at $36.55 million.
Experts suggest Indian goods may be reaching Pakistan through third countries such as the UAE and Singapore.
Here is how indirect trade routes may be helping Indian goods reach Pakistan despite the ban.
